item.title: U.S. Skier Lindsey Vonn Confirms Complex Tibia Bone Fracture After Olympic Crash
item.description: Lindsey Vonn confirmed she suffered a complex tibia bone fracture in Sunday's Olympic crash, with her father saying she won't race again. The post U.S. Skier Lindsey Vonn Confirms Complex Tibia Bone Fracture After Olympic Crash appeared first on Just Women's Sports.
